newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates mainly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates mainly unchanged.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was broadly steady against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly stable this week in quiet trade focused on swaps.
"There were no changes in Saudi deposit rates. They remained at the same level as last week," one Riyadh-based dealer said on Thursday. "Activity focused on swaps," he added.
The spot riyal firmed fractionally to 3.7504/06 from 3.7505/07 to the dollar last week.
One-month deposit rates were put at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were at 6-5/16, 3/16.
